deploy-bot: Auto-promo failed for rollout v2026.03-canary. Pipeline `release/canary` -> job `integration-tests` exited 1 on runner `staging-03`

olga: I see repeated mount errors in the job log. Looks like `/var/lib/cache` failing to mount, error: `device busy` then `read-only filesystem`.

jamal: link to logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/98765 (first failing step `setup-cache`)

sophia: can someone try re-running just the setup stage? might be an ephemeral runner quirk.

olga: re-run kicked off: `./ci retry --job integration-tests --build 98765`

devops-bot: rerun started on runner `staging-07` (replacing staging-03).

deploy-bot: rerun completed, still failing but different error now: `pip wheel cache corrupted: incompatible metadata` on step `build-wheels`.

jamal: hmm this smells like a corrupted cache artifact in our cache backend (redis-backed index + s3 blobs). Could be a partial upload during last GC.

olga: I can purge cache for the job key `wheel-build-3c4b` and re-trigger. Any objections to purging across canary?

release-coordinator: hold the auto-promo. We need to decide: either purge cache and force rerun for canary, or pin canary to previous image digest and promote manually after tests pass. Change window in 40m.

sophia: prefer pin then manual promote — lower blast radius. Purging could affect other in-flight jobs.

jamal: agree with pin. To be concrete: pin deploy image tag `redwood-inference:canary@sha256:abc123dead` -> manual promote if smoke/integration pass on that digest. I can prepare the promote job.

olga: steps to pin locally: `kubectl set image deployment/redwood-canary redwood=registry.redwood/release:sha-abc123dead -n staging` and then run `./ci trigger --pipeline smoke-tests --image-digest abc123dead`

devops-bot: note: pin requires updating rollout metadata and annotating release notes with `pinned-for-canary` and reason `CI cache corruption on runner staging-03` for audit.

release-coordinator: jamal, olga — proceed with pin and manual promote. Please add a short rollback plan to the thread when done (how to revert pin, who approves).

jamal: pinned now and triggered smoke-tests on digest abc123dead. Smoke started. `./ci status --build 98766`

olga: added annotation in release metadata: `pinned_canary=true`, `pin_reason=cache-corrupt-staging-03`

deploy-bot: smoke-tests passed on pinned digest. Integration-suite queued on staging-07.

sophia: good, but we should still investigate cache backend. I'll open a ticket and loop infra.

jamal: created INFRA-4921 with logs and repro steps. Assigning to @devops-team.

release-coordinator: manual promote scheduled in 10m if integration passes. If anything else flakey, rollback plan: revert to previous stable digest `sha256:ff22aa00` and abort release; notify customers on status page. Approvers: @sophia @olga.

olga: ack. I'll keep an eye on the integration job and confirm before promote. :eyes:
